# Privacy notice: support chat

**Controller:** ACME Home Energy GmbH, Hauptstr. 5, 10115 Berlin. DPO: privacy@acme-energy.example.

**Purpose and legal basis.** We process your chat messages to answer your support request
(Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, performance of your contract) and to improve answer quality and handle
complaints (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, legitimate interest).

**AI assistant.** Replies are generated by an AI assistant operated on our behalf by OpenAI Ireland
Ltd. (processor). You can ask for a human agent at any time.

**Recipients.** OpenAI (processor, EU region), our customer-care team.

**Retention.** Chat transcripts are stored for 2 years and then deleted automatically.

**Your rights.** Right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, portability and
the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. Contact privacy@acme-energy.example.
